name: sud-d
description: SUD-D — Windows Electron Desktop Control Center

scripts.test: pnpm --filter @sud-d/domain build && pnpm --filter @sud-d/mcp-gateway build && cross-env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron ./node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @sud-d/domain build && pnpm --filter @sud-d/contracts build && pnpm --filter @sud-d/infrastructure build && pnpm --filter @sud-d/application build && pnpm --filter @sud-d/mcp-gateway build && pnpm --filter @sud-d/desktop build
